title: Subscription period choices
decision: The owner is told once when a period ends and not again while the shop stays limited; only the owner reads the subscription; one paid month bought on a day runs through the day before the same day of the next month, and an early payment adds to the current period
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 32
rationale: BR-27 says whole months from the later of today and the paid-through date but not whether the day of payment is itself a paid day
